headline: Computer Science and Engineering Undergraduate & Competitive Programmer at Daffodil International University
shortBio: I am Minhajul Islam, a Computer Science student at Daffodil International University. I enjoy algorithms, practical software projects, programming education, and turning difficult problems into clear solutions.
extendedBio: I focus on competitive programming, algorithms, and practical academic software projects. Alongside my studies at Daffodil International University, I support programming labs as a PPS Lab Prefect, mentor junior students, and contribute to university programming contests as a problem setter and judging director at DIU ACM Lab.
